entities.summary: Air Astana Flight 1388 was a repositioning flight from Lisbon to Almaty, with a refueling stop in Minsk. On 11 November 2018, shortly after takeoff, it experienced severe control issues. After 90 minutes, it landed safely at Beja Airbase situated in southern Portugal, with no fatalities.
